ledger.x: c. 1650: the Kingdom of Rwanda. Infobox 'Established: c. 1650', with Ruganzu I Bwimba as the 17th-century king; the origins 'seem to date to a period from the 14th to the 16th centuries'. The core is the researcher's reading.
Under Rwabugiri (1867-1895): Bugoyi, Bwishaza and Kingogo are annexed.
